title: Triple check your free trial cancellation (check web not app)
body:
This app plays snakey games by making 10 more apps that you could subscribe to, some I didn’t and when I cancelled free trial it didn’t cancel across, the options didn’t even appear on the app. Only once I got charged and figure it out on the website I realized I have $100 charges from 3 more apps, very snakey :)

Not a good way to gain loyal customers, and for an app that is trying to make better daily habits, this thing is overwhelming and all over the place. Not recommended
